Root cause: the pointer's harp seats with the zero-band cell. A probe seated inside a line's band, back at its seat's arg plus 1 turn, is still one line short until it passes the band. Fix (src/sound.js): the pointer's harp keeps its seat {phi, c} (harpReset and the first point). When a step lands within the band of phi + k (k is not the last lap reached), the trigger moves to c + 5k in the direction of travel and plucks the line between, as harpClose does. It runs once per arrival, so a hand held at the lap's end does not chatter. Every pluck is a state change, so nothing is counted twice. Node test t_sound.js has 13 new checks and passes 151/151. Touch laps 12 to 60 px from 0.5 to 25 degrees, and 6 px (D-only zone) from 5.7 degrees, give 1 D. Falling laps from 3 degrees above and below give 1 D down. Two laps give 2. Out-and-back 0.9 turn gives 0. A finger held after the lap, or held with no lap, plays 0 notes. With the lap turned off, 9 of these checks fail, as the verifier measured. In the app, sound_v152_cmd.js section 8 (new; 390x844 Android, touch): 15 px from 3, 5 and 8 degrees and 30 px from 3 degrees give 1 D up and 5 notes, with 0 notes held. 6 px from 5.7 degrees gives 1 D and 1 note (it was silent).
